# Privacy Policy

<!-- Generated by npm run generate:legal from legal/privacy-policy.json. Do not edit manually. -->

## Privacy Overview

Cairn is a local-first desktop application. Cairn's developer does not operate a service that collects your project data, and the application does not include product analytics or telemetry.

## Data Cairn Does Not Collect

Cairn does not send your project files, operation history, account information, or usage activity to a Cairn-operated backend because Cairn does not operate one.

## Data Stored Locally

Cairn stores project synchronization metadata, operation history, object and blob data, session and activity history, project configuration, and recovery data on your device. If you configure GitHub integration, Cairn stores repository configuration locally and protects the GitHub token with Electron safeStorage, using the operating-system-backed protection available on your device.

## Peer-to-Peer Collaboration

When you create or join a Cairn room, collaboration data needed to synchronize the selected project is transmitted directly between participating peers over the local or chosen network connection. Synchronization traffic is encrypted in transit between authenticated Cairn peers.

## Local Network Discovery

When local discovery is enabled, Cairn uses mDNS to advertise and discover compatible peers on the local network. Discovery exposes non-secret service, peer, protocol, and network metadata needed to find peers. It does not broadcast the room secret.

## GitHub Integration

Only when you explicitly request a GitHub export or pull request does Cairn communicate with GitHub's API. GitHub may process the repository identifiers, authentication credentials, and project or file content necessary to complete that requested action, subject to GitHub's own terms and privacy practices.

## Diagnostics

Diagnostics remain local unless you manually copy and share them. Cairn does not automatically upload diagnostics. Diagnostic output excludes room credentials.

## Data Retention and Deletion

Locally stored Cairn data remains on your device until it is removed through Cairn, by deleting the relevant project or application data, or by uninstalling the application and removing its local data. Data sent to GitHub is retained under GitHub's policies.

## Third-Party Services

GitHub is used only for user-requested GitHub functionality. Cairn does not use a developer-operated analytics, telemetry, or cloud-storage service.

## Security

Cairn uses local operating-system-backed credential protection when available and encrypts peer synchronization traffic in transit. No security measure can eliminate every risk; protect your device, room credentials, and GitHub credentials.

## Changes to This Policy

Updates are published in this repository and included in released application materials.

## Contact

For privacy questions, open an issue at https://github.com/lol40560/Cairn/issues.
